# TalkToGuruji Love Match

> Love Match Numerology Compatibility Report: a 12-page PDF for two people, made from both partners' names and dates of birth, with an overall compatibility (affinity) score, each person's Life Path / destiny and soul-urge numbers, how the two numbers interact, and guidance for the relationship. Available in English, Hindi, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada and Malayalam.

The site's pages are built with JavaScript. For the full information in plain HTML (what the report contains, price, how to buy, delivery, refund summary, FAQ and contact), read [info.html](/info.html).

Start with a free compatibility score. The full report costs Rs 599, is paid through Razorpay, and is delivered instantly as a PDF on WhatsApp and by email. Run by Inno-One Service LLP, Noida, India.
